blocks.text: Real-world analogue: A cenote under an open ceiling, a white coral garden, a bioluminescent cave, a quiet dry garden, and an arboretum reflected in black water.

World relation: Continuity preserves incomplete lives; Quiet World space protects them from immediate classification; Crafted World architecture gives discarded sensations and temporary bodies a shared form.

Connection to newer locations: It relates to the Coral Data Labyrinth, Salt Mirror Archive, River of Deferred Reflections, Glacial Memory Fjord, and Orchard of Borrowed Moons. Each makes incompatible times or identities visible in one environment.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: What a system calls temporary can still be lived. The Garden is an ecology of experiences that were supposed to leave no inhabitant behind.
